summary.notes: The original offline assignment classified 287 baseline deficit cells in these tables (not all their mandatory cells). Orchestrator qualification on 2026-09-14 validated and enabled the eight entries below. The remaining 279 baseline cells require backend work; the count is not CTS coverage or conformance.

qualification.oracle: BGRA8 VideoOut-target readback; typed UINT/SINT shaders, asymmetric UNORM/SNORM/sRGB fixtures, and nearest-versus-linear checkerboards

promotion_procedure: 1. In a private qualification build, include the candidate capability in the witnessed argument of its SAMPLED_PACKED row in src/texture_format.c. Sampling with upload requires both SAMPLED_IMAGE and TRANSFER_DST; linear filtering additionally requires SAMPLED_IMAGE_LINEAR. Do not publish the promotion before both physical runs pass.
2. Build the native graphics diagnostic that performs the named operation.

3. Run it twice on the console with the same SELF image; both runs must produce the exact expected value for every case, a complete ps5log/1 stream, BYE, zero retained allocations and a verified exact-title Close Game.
4. Record SELF/artifact hashes, firmware and both log digests in VALIDATION.md and keep the promotion only if both runs match; otherwise revert the flag and keep the cell a blocker.

entries.enablement: SAMPLED_IMAGE and TRANSFER_DST in the enabled mask for VK_FORMAT_A8B8G8R8_UNORM_PACK32
entries.minimal_gpu_operation: Create a 2D optimal-tiling image with usage SAMPLED|TRANSFER_DST, upload an asymmetric texel set through the ordinary buffer-to-image path, encode the T#/S# with ps5vk_texture_descriptor, sample with a nearest sampler in a fragment shader and read pixels from the diagnostic BGRA8 target.
entries.expected_result: exact BGRA8-target readback word 0xff4080c0 (R=0x40, G=0x80, B=0xc0, A=0xff), identical to the same bytes uploaded as VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM; an RGBA8 target instead stores 0xffc08040
entries.host_test_limit: Host tests prove descriptor word 0x03800000, the identity selectors, the texel size and the copy/layout arithmetic; only the texture unit decodes the packed component order.

entries.enablement: SAMPLED_IMAGE and TRANSFER_DST in the enabled mask for VK_FORMAT_A8B8G8R8_SNORM_PACK32
entries.minimal_gpu_operation: As the UNORM entry with the SNORM descriptor word 0x03900000 and an asymmetric positive texel set that distinguishes signed from unsigned normalization.
entries.expected_result: exact readback 0xff4080c1, identical to the recorded VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SNORM witness for the same bytes
entries.host_test_limit: As the UNORM entry: the sign handling and component order are decided by the texture unit.

entries.enablement: SAMPLED_IMAGE and TRANSFER_DST in the enabled mask for VK_FORMAT_A8B8G8R8_SRGB_PACK32
entries.minimal_gpu_operation: As the UNORM entry with the sRGB descriptor word 0x08200000 and the recorded VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SRGB texel set.
entries.expected_result: exact readback 0xff370d04, identical to the recorded VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SRGB witness for the same bytes
entries.host_test_limit: The sRGB decode (0x80 to 0x37, 0x40 to 0x0d, 0x20 to 0x04) happens in the texture unit; a host test can only check that the sRGB descriptor word is selected.

entries.enablement: SAMPLED_IMAGE and TRANSFER_DST in the enabled mask for VK_FORMAT_A8B8G8R8_UINT_PACK32
entries.minimal_gpu_operation: As the UNORM entry with the integer descriptor word 0x03c00000, a typed usampler in the fragment shader and no linear filtering (Vulkan forbids it for integer formats).
entries.expected_result: exact readback 0xff336699, identical to the recorded VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UINT witness for the same bytes
entries.host_test_limit: The typed sampled-image ABI and integer component order are consumed by the texture unit and the compiled shader; the host contract fixes only the descriptor word and the shader interface class.

entries.enablement: SAMPLED_IMAGE and TRANSFER_DST in the enabled mask for VK_FORMAT_A8B8G8R8_SINT_PACK32
entries.minimal_gpu_operation: As the UINT entry with the signed integer descriptor word 0x03d00000, a typed isampler and negative component values.
entries.expected_result: exact readback 0xff40a0e0, identical to the recorded VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SINT witness for the same bytes
entries.host_test_limit: As the UINT entry for the signed case.

entries.enablement: SAMPLED_IMAGE_LINEAR in the enabled mask for VK_FORMAT_A8B8G8R8_UNORM_PACK32
entries.minimal_gpu_operation: Upload the opaque black/opaque white 2x2 checkerboard used by the recorded filter probes and sample its centre twice: once with VK_FILTER_NEAREST and once with VK_FILTER_LINEAR.
entries.expected_result: nearest 0xff000000 and linear 0xff808080 in both byte-identical runs
entries.host_test_limit: The filter hardware decides the interpolated value; the host contract only proves that linear filtering is gated on a non-integer format and that the sampler encoding is accepted.

entries.enablement: SAMPLED_IMAGE_LINEAR in the enabled mask for VK_FORMAT_A8B8G8R8_SNORM_PACK32
entries.minimal_gpu_operation: The same checkerboard probe with the recorded SNORM fixture (black alpha 0x7f, white components 0x7f) and both filters.
entries.expected_result: nearest 0xff000000 and linear 0xff808080, matching the recorded VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SNORM filter witness

entries.enablement: SAMPLED_IMAGE_LINEAR in the enabled mask for VK_FORMAT_A8B8G8R8_SRGB_PACK32
entries.minimal_gpu_operation: The same opaque black/opaque white checkerboard with the sRGB descriptor word and both filters; the recorded sRGB fixture is used unchanged.
entries.expected_result: nearest 0xff000000 and linear 0xff808080, matching the recorded VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SRGB filter witness
entries.host_test_limit: As the UNORM filter entry; 0 and 255 are sRGB fixed points, so decode must be covered by the sampled-image entry above.

blocker_classification.detail: The compute profile installs neither format_properties nor image_properties and creates no graphics objects, so every mandatory format cell of the two tables is a blocker for that profile by construction.
vkCmdBlitImage rejects every call: there is no scaling/filtering packet and no bounded CPU contract, and BLIT is not COPY, so no BLIT_SRC/BLIT_DST bit may be published.

Buffer views and texel-buffer descriptors exist only for the R32 UINT/SINT/SFLOAT uniform rows; there is no storage-texel-buffer descriptor type and no buffer-data-format mapping for the remaining formats.

Only B8G8R8A8_UNORM and R8G8B8A8_UNORM have a render-target encoding and a clear/draw/readback route; the native graphics compiler additionally requires colorWriteMask 15 with blendEnable false, so no blend bit is publishable either.
There is no storage-image descriptor, image-load/store ABI or atomic path in the shader interface, so storage images and atomics cannot be inferred from texture descriptors.
All eight A8B8G8R8_* sampled/filter entries were qualified in two identical-artifact runs per diagnostic group and are now enabled.
B8G8R8A8_UNORM and B8G8R8A8_SRGB sampling needs a component swap that the pinned GPL reference does not encode and that no console witness covers; the profile deliberately does not sample BGRA.
